objective: Speak with Velora Nitely in the Undercity.

description: It is said that, before her death, Velora Nitely was one of the finest armorsmiths in Lordaeron.  Death, it seems, has not decreased her talents.  Speak with Velora--she will make your brutal legguards.
Velora plies her trade in the Undercity of Lordaeron, in the trade quarter.
completion: You are here for leg armor? Great!
Um... am I making the armor for you, or are you making it for me?
That was joke. Was it funny? I can't tell... I lost my sense of humor the same time I lost my sense of smell. Which was about the same time I stopped breathing.
